<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Genspark started in 2023 as a Perplexity-style AI search engine, creating “Sparkpages” that synthesized web results

    launch.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Think of Genspark as a command center for AI work. You describe what you want, and it orchestrates 30+ AI models

<h3 class="wp-block-heading">AI Call For Me: The Viral Feature</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This feature went viral in Japan, where users asked the AI to make resignation calls to their employers. Here’s how

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">You describe what you need (book a restaurant, check business hours, reschedule a delivery). The AI uses OpenAI’s

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Independent testing showed an 83% success rate across 47 phone calls. The failures mostly came from complex automated
    menus or calls requiring human judgment.</p>

<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Q: How fast do Genspark credits get used up?</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>A:</strong> Credit consumption varies by task. Basic searches use few credits, but video generation, complex

<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Q: Is Genspark AI safe and secure?</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>A:</strong> Genspark claims GDPR-level compliance and offers a SOC2-compliant enterprise edition. However,
